description: This file defines a PHP class DSum which implements the DSUM function for database calculations in a spreadsheet context. It extends a base class DatabaseAbstract and provides functionality to compute the sum of values in a database column that meet specified criteria.

classes.name: DSum
classes.description: A class providing the DSUM database function implementation for calculating sums based on criteria.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the sum of values in a specified database column that meet given criteria, optionally returning null on error.
